# Duo Tax

> Australia's leading property depreciation and valuation expert providing ATO-compliant tax schedules, valuations, and investment calculators for rental property investors.

Duo Tax specializes in quantity surveying and property tax services across Australia, serving investors, accountants, and mortgage brokers. The site offers multilingual services in Vietnamese, Chinese, and Korean to serve Australia's diverse investor community.

- Tax Depreciation

## Calculators & Tools

- [Rental Property Depreciation Calculator](https://duotax.com.au/property-tax-depreciation/calculator): Interactive depreciation calculator for property tax estimation
- [Stamp Duty Calculator Australia](https://duotax.com.au/stamp-duty-calculator): State-by-state stamp duty calculator for property purchases
- [Construction Cost Calculator](https://duotax.com.au/construction-cost-calculator): Free construction cost estimation tool by state and property type
- [Replacement Cost Calculator](https://duotax.com.au/replacement-cost-calculator): Home rebuild cost calculator for insurance coverage determination
- [Negative Gearing Calculator](https://duotax.com.au/negative-gearing-calculator): Free negative gearing calculator for rental property investment analysis
- [Rental Yield Calculator](https://duotax.com.au/rental-yield-calculator): Rental yield and ROI calculator for property investment analysis
- [Scrap Value Calculator](https://duotax.com.au/scrap-value-calculator): Asset depreciation calculator using prime cost and diminishing value
